connector.name: Fluxmail
connector.registryDescription: Read, search, draft, send, and organize email through Gmail, Outlook, and IMAP/SMTP mailboxes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package fluxmail. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the churichard account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Optional override for Fluxmail's built-in Desktop OAuth client ID.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client secret paired with a custom Google OAuth client ID.

env.name: FLUXMAIL_DATA_DIR
env.description: Directory for the Fluxmail database, encryption key, and stored settings.

env.name: FLUXMAIL_LICENSE_KEY
env.description: Optional Fluxmail license key for paid plan limits.
